paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Your roof can collect rainwater. The amount depends on roof area, rainfall and losses.
paragraphs.currentDraft: Marulelo a hao a ka bokella metsi a pula. Bongata bo itshetlehile ka boholo ba marulelo, pula le tahlehelo.
paragraphs.candidate: Marulelo a hao a ka bokella metsi a pula. Bongata bo itshetlehile ka boholo ba marulelo, pula le tahlehelo.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Check whether the roof material is suitable for rainwater collection before connecting a tank.
paragraphs.currentDraft: Hlahloba hore na thepa ya marulelo e loketse ho bokella metsi a pula pele o hokela tanka.
paragraphs.candidate: Hlahloba hore na thepa ya marulelo e loketse ho bokella metsi a pula pele o hokela tanka.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Use the roof area seen from above and local rainfall records. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
paragraphs.currentDraft: Sebedisa boholo ba marulelo jwalo ka ha bo bonwa ho tloha hodimo le ditlaleho tsa pula ya sebaka seo. Ebe o dumella metsi a fosang koto, a kgelohang kapa a kgaphatsehang ha tanka e tletse.
paragraphs.candidate: Sebedisa boholo ba marulelo jwalo ka ha bo bonwa ho tloha hodimo le ditlaleho tsa pula ya sebaka seo. Ebe o dumella metsi a fosang koto, a kgelohang kapa a kgaphatsehang ha tanka e tletse.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: An annual total does not tell you how much water will be available during a dry spell. Compare supply with the uses you plan.
paragraphs.currentDraft: Palo yohle ya selemo le selemo ha e o jwetse hore na metsi a makae a tla fumaneha nakong ya komello. Bapisa phepelo le tshebediso eo o e rerileng.
paragraphs.candidate: An annual total does not tell you how much water will be available during a dry spell. Bapisa phepelo le tshebediso eo o e rerileng.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Roof runoff can carry dust, droppings and other contamination. A first-flush diverter keeps some of the first runoff out of the tank.
paragraphs.currentDraft: Metsi a theohang marulelong a ka nka lerole, mantle le tshilafalo e nngwe. Sekgelo sa ho qala ha phallo (first-flush diverter) se boloka karolo e nngwe ya metsi a pele a phallang kantle ho tanka.
paragraphs.candidate: Metsi a theohang marulelong a ka nka lerole, mantle le tshilafalo e nngwe. Sekgelo sa ho qala ha phallo (first-flush diverter) se boloka karolo e nngwe ya metsi a pele a phallang kantle ho tanka.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: The required diversion depends on the roof and system. Use the supplier's sizing and maintenance instructions; there is no single volume for every roof.
paragraphs.currentDraft: Bongata bo hlokahalang ba ho kgeloha bo itshetlehile ka marulelo le tsamaiso. Sebedisa ditaelo tsa boholo le tlhokomelo tse tswang ho mofani wa thepa; ha ho na bophahamo bo le bong bakeng sa marulelo a mang le a mang.
paragraphs.candidate: Bongata bo hlokahalang ba ho kgeloha bo itshetlehile ka marulelo le tsamaiso. Use the supplier's sizing and maintenance instructions; there is no single volume for every roof.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A diverter does not make the remaining water safe to drink.
paragraphs.currentDraft: Sekgelo (diverter) ha se etse hore metsi a setseng a bolokehele ho nowa.
paragraphs.candidate: Sekgelo (diverter) ha se etse hore metsi a setseng a bolokehele ho nowa.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Tank size depends on water demand, rain, roof area and the length of dry periods.
paragraphs.currentDraft: Boholo ba tanka bo itshetlehile ka tlhoko ya metsi, pula, boholo ba marulelo le bolelele ba dinako tsa komello.
paragraphs.candidate: Boholo ba tanka bo itshetlehile ka tlhoko ya metsi, pula, boholo ba marulelo le the length of dry periods.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: List the intended uses and estimate their demand from your own records. Compare that with supply through the seasons.
paragraphs.currentDraft: Ngola tshebediso e rerilweng mme o hakanye tlhoko ya yona ho tswa ditlalehong tsa hao. Bapisa seo le phepelo ho pholletsa le dihla.
paragraphs.candidate: Ngola tshebediso e rerilweng mme o hakanye tlhoko ya yona ho tswa ditlalehong tsa hao. Bapisa seo le phepelo ho pholletsa le dihla.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Plan what you will do when stored water runs low. A province name alone cannot tell you the tank size you need.
paragraphs.currentDraft: Rala seo o tla se etsa ha metsi a bolokilweng a qala ho fela. Lebitso la provense feela le ke ke la o jwetsa boholo ba tanka eo o e hlokang.
paragraphs.candidate: Rala seo o tla se etsa ha metsi a bolokilweng a qala ho fela. Lebitso la provense feela le ke ke la o jwetsa boholo ba tanka eo o e hlokang.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Keep the tank covered, screen openings against insects, and maintain the roof, gutters and diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.
paragraphs.currentDraft: Boloka tanka e kwahetswe, sefa menyako kgahlanong le dikokwanyana, mme o hlokomele marulelo, dikoto le sekgelo (diverter). Boloka metsi a pula a arohane le diphaephe tsa metsi a nowang.
paragraphs.candidate: Boloka tanka e kwahetswe, screen openings against insects, mme o hlokomele marulelo, dikoto le sekgelo (diverter). Boloka metsi a pula a arohane le diphaephe tsa metsi a nowang.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Water that looks clear may still contain germs or chemicals. Ask the local health authority about testing and treatment suited to the intended use.
paragraphs.currentDraft: Metsi a shebahalang a hlwekile a ka nna a ba le dikokwana-hloko (germs) kapa dikhemikhale. Botsa balaodi ba bophelo bo botle ba sebaka seo ka diteko le kalafo tse loketseng tshebediso e rerilweng.
paragraphs.candidate: Water that looks clear may still contain germs or chemicals. Botsa balaodi ba bophelo bo botle ba sebaka seo ka diteko le kalafo tse loketseng tshebediso e rerilweng.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A basic filter alone is not a drinking-water guarantee. Water used on food crops also needs a safety assessment.
paragraphs.currentDraft: Sefa sa mantlha feela hase tiiso ya metsi a nowang. Metsi a sebediswang dijalong tsa dijo le ona a hloka tlhahlobo ya polokeho.
paragraphs.candidate: Sefa sa mantlha feela hase tiiso ya metsi a nowang. Metsi a sebediswang dijalong tsa dijo le ona a hloka tlhahlobo ya polokeho.
